transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (722x748) screenshot of an unbranded snow-profile app -> source_format 'other'. Height scale 2.7 px/cm (100 at y=302, 0 at y=572); boundaries from the H-column boundary lines and bar edges (92/76/50/25/10/9/0, +-0.5 cm; 4F->F bar edge at ~25.5). Hardness classes calibrated on the axis label centres (K 114, P 222, 1F 276, 4F 303, F 317.5 px; bars grow leftward from x~329); the 76-50 bar ends 7 px beyond 4F (~0.26 class) -> 4F+ (uncertain). Printed date 22/12/2013 differs from the file-name code 131221 (printed wins). No temperature profile drawn (surface temp -13.0 C in header only). The R column contains graphic marks (diagonals, X, '+') whose meaning is not decoded. 'Hidden: Stress' legend refers to the cross-hatched bars.
